flags: Only one Office of Readings hymn is printed (no noctu/interdiu I/II split), so option_num 1, wkday null for the whole section.
Verbum supernum runs p. 5 -> p. 6 (final double bar after 'Amen' on p. 6).

p. 6 line 'Ad libitum hymnus cantari potest in tono hymni Vox clara de laudibus matutinis' is a tone-substitution rubric for Verbum supernum, not a separate chant, so no row; Vox clara itself begins on p. 6 (Lauds) and belongs to p. 6's spec.
